Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 28-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: CIV 1004/CIV_1004 ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIV 1004]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Distinguish between sustainable growth and environmental sustainability.                              (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1B)               What are the possible solutions for the Sundarbans crisis?                                            (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"  
  
2A)               Describe on how citizen science have helped in solving wildlife conflicts and conservation of Amur    (5)  
  falcon .  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)               Define the ecological footprint and explain why it is considered a more comprehensive metric for      (5)  
  environmental impact ?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3A)               How does air pollution contribute to climate change and acid rain?                                    (5)  
3B)               Explain the effect of nutrient loading and salinization on the water quality.                         (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)               Discuss the legal framework for water resource management in India with reference to the              (5)  
  Easement Rights and the River Boards Act.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4B)               Discuss how the Indian law ensures safety from hazardous industries and immediate relief to           (5)  
  affected persons in case of any accident.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5A)               Effective watershed management can reduce the severity of floods in urban areas. Justify this         (5)  
  statement.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5B)               Discuss the geophysical and hydrological types of natural disasters.                                  (5)
